entities.name: Negotiated WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element containing negotiated WUS (Wake Up Signal) assistance information between UE and network.

entities.name: UE supports WUS assistance
entities.description: Condition that the UE supports WUS assistance functionality.

entities.name: MME supports and accepts WUS assistance
entities.description: Condition that the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance.

entities.name: UE not attaching for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not performing an attach procedure for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: Network includes Negotiated WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE when all conditions are met.

relations.description: Network behavior establishes the inclusion of the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE.
Network behavior is guarded by the condition that UE supports WUS assistance.
Network behavior is guarded by the condition that MME supports and accepts WUS assistance.
Network behavior is guarded by the condition that UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services.
